sources.static_isolation: Either supply below100mV or qualifying disconnected supply; complementary supply must be within recommended conditions.
sources.floating_definition: Externally undriven, external leakage<=10nA; inputs low recommended before disconnect.
sources.leakage_scope: Ioff rows: A/B ports at0..5.5V, one supply0V. Ioff-float rows: port atGND. Do not use these rows as a complete OE or arbitrary partial-rail feed bound.
sources.sequencing: Glitch-free supply sequencing is documented. It does not specify a maximum collapse-to-high-Z response or clear external READY state.
sources.timing: No maximum supply-collapse-to-high-Z time established. The36ns OE-to-B table entry is a different path.

sources.timing_conditions: Typical table:25C,VIN3.6V unless otherwise specified,CL0.1uF,RL100ohm. Timing control edges100ns. RQOD short for cited fall example.
sources.limits: QOD R and timing are not max bounds. VIN shutdown current is not a complete VOUT feed limit. No reverse isolation or QOD behavior during arbitrary VIN collapse is accepted by this review. Section 8.3.3.1 states that QOD strength decreases as VIN falls.
